text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — kicking off a short access snapshot for infra and data-prod groups today. Goal: find admin overlaps, stale grants, and ownerless roles. Will upload CSV when finished.
Carlos Rivera: ETA?
Maya Chen: by EOD PST. Running `./tools/iam-query --org redwood --groups infra,data-prod --format csv` and pulling KMS bindings too.
Nate Brooks: Include cross-project KMS grants — last sweep missed a few.
Samir Patel: Suggest auto-create remediation tickets and sort by `justification_age`. /remediate-bot could assign.
Elle Johnson: Quick Q — treat workload-identity SAs with project-level editor as "elevated"?
Maya Chen: Yes. Any SA with project roles/editor or roles/owner on prod projects -> mark `elevated`. We'll flag WI SAs separately.
sec-automation-bot: scan started for groups infra,data-prod. ETA ~12m.
Carlos Rivera: If we find ownerless admin roles, playbook? ticket + 72h? temp removal?
Maya Chen: Proposed playbook: 1) create ticket, team: security, owner: unassigned; 2) notify ownerless-admins queue; 3) 72h review window; 4) if no response, temp-remove and monitor 24h; 5) escalate to sec-oncall if breakage. Ack?
Carlos Rivera: ack
Nate Brooks: Attach audit log snapshots to tickets so owners see recent activity: https://logs.redwood.internal/access/1702101111
Maya Chen: Will attach redacted audit links + CSV. Adding `risk_reason` column for triage.
Samir Patel: Drafting rollback snippet for removals: `iam-grant --ticket $T --principal $P --role $R --reason "revert temp-prune"`. Will add to runbook.
Maya Chen: tagging sec-oncall @Elle Johnson for FYI
Elle Johnson: I can cover triage windows if anything spikes during sweep.
Maya Chen: Initial snapshot posted: https://files.redwood/priv-snapshots/1702101111.csv :lock:
Carlos Rivera: scanning — found 3 svcacct with ownerless admin role on prod-analytics and 1 cross-project KMS grant to external-project.
Nate Brooks: filing tickets for the ownerless ones with proposed mitigations and risk windows.
Maya Chen: pinned checklist in ticket template: 1) confirm owner/team 2) open ticket 3) 72h review 4) temp-remove if no response 5) monitor 24h and revert if jobs fail
Samir Patel: Any objections to a low-blast-radius canary prune next week to validate the playbook?
Elle Johnson: +1 to canary
Maya Chen: Scheduling canary prune Tue 08:00 UTC. Notifying infra, analytics, and oncall.
sec-automation-bot: scan complete. Summary: 42 elevated principals, 3 ownerless admin bindings, 12 stale grants >180d. CSV and initial tickets attached.
Carlos Rivera: For KMS-related tickets add KMS-rotation team as watcher.
Maya Chen: Added KMS-rotation watchers. Thanks everyone :pray:
